_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Labour administration (24 Feb 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (ended ~50 years of Labour control) and formed the Cabinet 26 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.
_intervention_history_flag: Sandwell was under Best Value statutory intervention 22 March 2022 to 22 March 2024 (commissioners Bromley-Derry + Taylor). Now exited but under heightened scrutiny.

administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (41 of 72), ending ~50 years of Labour control. Leader Cllr Ray Nock (sworn in 26 May 2026). Part of the West Midlands Combined Authority (Mayor Richard Parker, Labour).

mtfs.intervention_status: No current S114/EFS/BVN, BUT recently exited a Best Value statutory intervention (commissioners 2022-2024). DSG High Needs deficit small ~GBP 4.17m.
mtfs._source: Sandwell MBC 2026/27 Budget + MTFS (docs s31811 + s31886), full Council 24 Feb 2026, pulled and read directly.
